en: Ye looking for Hogral?  Well did ye check the tavern?  Och!  If yer looking for a rogue, and a dwarf one at that, ye should start in the Inn!  Go have a look already.
You challenged us and we have come. Where is this master you speak of?
You two are surely star-crossed lovers who have found each other. There is much happiness in your future.
Me feast on you all!

If you ask me, the best part about fishing is its slow pace.  It gives one time to think, to reflect on past events and to plan for future ones.$B$BOh, and it's also a great excuse to drink.  Heavily.
I want to buy another stink bomb!
You seek someone who cares for animals?  Then you should look for Seriadne outside the Inn in Dolanaar.  She is the one that you seek.
I can not train you. You need to talk to your class trainer.
%s Takes a Deep Beath
My life means nothing!  Our sacred task is all!
You have outworn your welcome!
I'm busy, $n. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.
I installed a new device in our car's matrix regulometer.  That should increase its velocity quotient by a factor of no less than fifteen!
Ah yes, and promptly delivered.  As always, it's a pleasure doing business with you, Corbett.
There is an alchemist that lives up in the hills between Northshire and Stormwind that might be of some help.  Why don't you go pay him a visit?
Now that the coast is clear...
Commonly found on the lesser chromatic flight: Whelps, broodlings, lesser wyrmkin.
Dang! Fish aren't biting here either. I am gonna go back to my ol' fishin' hole!
When time permits, we must speak at length.  For we have much to discuss.
FREE!!!
Aaaaahhh! So close to escaping.
Yes, yes. I see you.$B$BBe on your way. You may have earned the trust of a few, but it will take more than that to prove it to me!
Can't help ya, $n. I only train rogues.
Umi sent you, didn't she?! She told me to expect a surprise, but I never thought that this is what she meant!
Krathok, I was once an armorsmith and wish to retake the hammer once more! Teach me the way of the armorsmith.
I smell an intruder...
You know who can really show you some things? Nogg! You go find him in Orgrimmar.
You'd better not be causing trouble, $n!
You think you just walk up to me and I start teaching you? Ha! You need to pay your dues like everyone else!
We chose to leave the protection and comfort of the Depths to exploit... er, I mean... hrm, yes that's right, EXPLORE the world.
Go to Orgrimmar, you will find her and her brood in the Valley of Honor.

Hiya! This workshop isn't mine, no! But one day after I finish training I am going to be an inventor, just like my hero, Marvon Rivetseeker.$B$BYou've never heard of him? Well it just so happens that he left quite some time ago to study some ancient troll ruins he kept talking about. He left in a zeppelin... not quite sure about where exactly he went...$B$BTanarasin? Tenkeris? Taneranisany?$B$B<Liv shakes her head.>$B$BNo, that's not it...
Times have changed. The young races will join us. You will never succeed.
At last, I have caught up with you, Nefarian. Surely you did not think you would escape the might of the other Aspects?
It is this night that our enemies fear us the most.  It is THIS night that we show our enemies what it means to stand against the Forsaken!

I welcome you, $N. And the Emerald Circle welcomes you.$B$BHopefully together we can help rejuventate and protect this once-mighty forest. Many forces seek to destroy it from without... and within.$B$BDo not be persuaded by the power here--it will only corrupt you, like it has this entire land.
This is gonna cost a bundle of gold. It's not comin' out of my pocket.
What?  Oh no, I don't care what you have to say.  I just enjoy inflicting pain.
